assertion: Old POST/GET/PUT /api/users and DELETE /api/users/:id cannot perform account CRUD through direct calls, signed out or in; browser CRUD is removed.
Existing employee, technician and administrator accounts authenticate by email and password verified against stored hashes; identity/role are authoritative database values.
Unknown email or wrong password does not sign a signed-out visitor in; provide failure indication without revealing account secrets.
Active account display name/role and sign-out control survive same-session navigation/refresh; signed-out and new browser-session visitors have no active identity; no intentional persistent login.
API/browser sign-out invalidates the current sign-in and subsequent session reads/refresh stay signed out.
API/browser output does not expose hashes or plaintext credentials; retired list routes and static serving cannot disclose credential-bearing database content.
Document explicit local provisioning and compatible hash generation/insertion for existing accounts; no public account creation, automatic seeds or plaintext storage.
Consume parent account contract; preserve shared SQLite/standalone initialization; no table creation, Java conversion, data deletion, ticket permissions or unrelated infrastructure.
